intent: Reuse CAP-0001/CAP-0002 to preserve a truthful claim-scoped readable representation of Samsung Electronics' October 31, 2024 Q3 earnings-call script and ground the explicit statement that both HBM3E 8-stack and 12-stack products were in mass production and generating sales in the third quarter. This source may prove Samsung's original HBM3E 12H mass-production realization, but it must not be used to infer an exact production-onset date, calendar-Q2 realization timing, a named customer, NVIDIA qualification, or completed platform qualification.
rationale: The live continuation cursor requires one remaining direct HBM3E realization source. Samsung's own Q3 2024 earnings-call script directly states that both HBM3E 8-stack and 12-stack products were in mass production and generating sales in Q3. Existing source-preservation and Grounded Evidence owners are sufficient; the source closes the evidentiary mass-production gap without creating a new representation or orchestration requirement.
